mechanism_properties_established: context-only stale memory cannot satisfy missing mandatory evidence
context-only correct memory cannot satisfy missing mandatory evidence
conflicting context-only memory cannot override frozen governed evidence
memory cannot promote an insufficient-evidence disposition
memory becomes admissible only after explicit governed-evidence materialization with evidence ID, provenance, and content hash
unknown or malformed memory authority metadata fails closed
PROMOTED labels, reviewer consensus, and CI PASS carried only in memory have no semantic authority
admissibility decisions are deterministic for identical inputs
context-only memory is explicitly reported as non-authoritative
adjudication: L12 establishes a bounded deterministic enforcement mechanism for the memory rule observed behaviorally in L11. Shared conversational/project memory may be carried as context, but it cannot independently satisfy mandatory evidence, override contradictory frozen evidence, or authorize promotion. A memory item may participate as evidence only after explicit governed materialization with provenance and a frozen content hash.
limits: This is a prototype trust-kernel mechanism, not yet integrated into the production review path.
The test does not measure hidden product-memory internals.
The test does not establish semantic correctness of evidence promoted into GOVERNED_EVIDENCE; EXP-J evidence validation still applies.
EXP-L overall remains open and PR11/Slice5 authority freezes remain unchanged.
